subject: DSM, splitting data into segments, resources?

messages.author: 5870ab3cb68290a6
messages.subject: DSM, splitting data into segments, resources?
parts:
Hi,

I'm hoping to do a density surface model with some line transect data, but I'm having trouble figuring out how to split my data into the shorter segments needed. The ETP dolphins dsm tutorial on the distance site mentions doing it in R or GIS, but I wonder if there are resources or examples to help me figure this out?

Thanks so much!
-Abigail

messages.author: 350dad0a615d36db
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] DSM, splitting data into segments, resources?
parts:
Hi Abigail, hi listfolks,

I've put together an example using the R library sf at:

http://workshops.distancesampling.org/online-dsm-2020/data-format/dsm-data-formatting.html

It's a draft at the moment, so if anyone has comments please do feel
free to contact me on or off list and I will try to improve the tutorial.

cheers,
--dave
